_comment: gdd-npc-dialogue.md §5.5 (player-side capability registry) + §5.6 (NPC-side effects-vs-PCs). Spells/proficiencies/powers with a social effect usable mid-dialogue. Data-defined per §5.5 (extensible by design: adding one is data + a dialogue-effect handler). Each entry: capability_id; source (spell|proficiency|power); actor_side (player|npc|both); targeting (npc|pc|self|party); save (the RAW save key, '' = none); dialogue_effect (the engine-applied effect tag the handler dispatches on); vs_pc (the PC-side bite when an NPC uses it on the party, §5.6); conceal (per-capability visibility flag — Jedidiah 2026-07-03: ships OFF, i.e. false = fully transparent in pre-alpha); raw anchor; notes. The engine resolution (saves, durations, slots) delegates to the real spell system at P4; P3 records the ENGINE DECISION (the effect state) on the mock path.

capabilities.notes: Save negates (+5 if target currently threatened by caster/allies). On failure: charmed state — attitude override to Friendly toward the caster; §6.6 offense triggers suppressed; extraordinary orders trigger the RAW additional save. On a PC: hostile-vs-charmer moves blocked; the charmed PC DEFECTS to the charmer's side in the combat roster (§12.1). Compulsion ceiling: cannot compel an affirmative act.
As charm_person for the mechanics tracked here.
Reveals only ACTIVELY hostile intent existing as game state (an accepted quest targeting this NPC, a planned ambush, recent hostile acts) — NOT alignment (RAW :623-624).
Reveals that an NPC is charmed or enspelled (not by whom); counterplay against charm (§5.6).

The RAW lie detector. On an NPC: each reply gains a surface-thought insert + the truth flag on any lie. On the party: the NPC learns ENGINE-KNOWN facts only (declared moves this session, active quests, visible intentions) — never private plans; grants a knows-your-mind per-issue bonus, flags free-text bluffs ineffective; aware PCs get the RAW save.
Requested of a divine NPC via request_action(cast_spell_for_hire) or offered via npc_offer: real HP restoration on acceptance; market fees or a Friendly per-issue favor.
Already implemented via InteractionResolver._is_charm_like (12+ results read as charm-like in the target's presence). Registry entry for completeness.
